zoom.source_crop: 1080x1480 from crop_y (150 music sets, 250 wooden runs)

backdrop: the round's own frame at 70%, filled to 16:9, downsampled 8x + blur 7, brightness 0.42, vignette, 14% #1e0c33 tint

countdown.ring: 14 px, #ffd650 arc for the time left

answer.card: white, 8 px #32c664 border, radius 34, check badge
answer.title: Poppins Black up to 66, balanced wrap, <=3 lines

progress.grid: 5 x 4 marbles, r 23, step 66, from y 330

transition.name: marble pop
transition.cover: glossy marble grows from the centre, radius 1.04 x half-diagonal x q^1.6, 7 px white rim
transition.uncover: the full marble bursts open from the centre, hole 1-(1-q)^1.8, rim fading

audio.sfx_cues: pop at each round start, whoosh under each cover and up-next slide, ticks on 3-2-1, ding on every reveal

thumbnail.layout: three cards cut below the round title, middle 470 px wide, sides 390 px at +/-7 deg, on #4a1d80 -> #12061f with scattered marbles
